messages:
Jordan H: quick midday async — what I did: followed up on last night's SLO blip for embeddings (eu-west). Root cause looks like batcher backlog + a cold-start path hitting a slower kernel. Filed TICKET-1427 and added temporary mitigations. :white_check_mark:
Jordan H: blockers: still need a small change in the kernel-selection config; I can do a patch but wanted an extra +1 on the perf test harness before canary.
Priya S: I reviewed TICKET-1427, left comments on the repro steps. I can own the canary rollout after you push the patch. :raised_hands:
Jordan H: thanks — will push the patch in ~30m. Patch includes changing default max_batch_time to 15ms for eu-west worker pool and enabling the warmup path for the small-seq workload.
Kevin M: noted. One ask — can we also add a short-lived metric to track batched queue depth per model? If we can graph that we can avoid surprises.
Jordan H: good idea — adding gauge: inference.batch_queue_depth tagged by model+region. I'll add to the patch.
Mira L: oncall notes: page history shows 3 pages overnight, all correlated to the same 5xx spike window. I've attached the summarized logs to TICKET-1427. Suggest we backfill a quick incident note in /incidents and mark as "minor" if patch resolves.
ops-bot: alert resolved: eu-west embeddings 5xx spike — condition cleared at 2025-11-12T03:42:10Z. Alert runbook run: restart-batcher (manual), increased warmup concurrency.
Priya S: small followups: can someone post the pre-canary checklist here so I can run it? I don't want to miss traffic shaping rules.
Jordan H: checklist: 1) run perf tests (tools/perf/run_embed.sh --seq 64 --rps 50), 2) update routing weight to 10% via rollout CLI, 3) watch SLO dashboards (latency P95, error rate), 4) rollback plan = revert routing weight to 0%. I'll paste commands:
Jordan H: ```bash
# perf test
./tools/perf/run_embed.sh --seq 64 --rps 50
# rollout
redwood rollout set --pool eu-west-embed --model redwood-embed-v1 --weight 10
```
Kevin M: I'll add the batch_queue_depth panels to the eu-west dashboard and set an alert if depth > 200 for 2m.
Mira L: blocker for me: want a short blameless note in the incident doc that explains the kernel mismatch so support and CS can reply consistently. Jordan, can you draft a 3-line summary once the patch lands?
Jordan H: yep — will draft and add to the ticket.
Priya S: once canary is stable I'll request a CR for the kernel-config change. tagging @Kevin M for perf review.
Kevin M: happy to review — will look after I add the dashboard panel.
Jordan H: timeline today: push patch + perf run (30–45m), start 10% canary (60m), observe for 2 hours, then decide rollback/rollforward. If anything looks odd ping me in thread or call.
Mira L: noted. I'll follow on the incident doc and archive the pages. Thanks all. :metal:
Jordan H: last thing — small housekeeping: reminder to merge any outstanding oncall playbook PRs before EOD so runbooks match the new metric names.
Priya S: on it.
Jordan H: thanks — signing off for now.
